question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word to fill in the blank.

Ram __failed__ initially but after a few years, he _________ in every field.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"failed"** means to be unsuccessful in achieving one's goal. (असफल होना)

 
 
• **Example: **Despite his best efforts, he failed the exam.
 
 
 
• **"Succeeded"** refers to achieving the desired aim or result, accomplishing an aim or purpose. (सफल होना)
 
 
• **Example: **After years of hard work, she finally succeeded in her business venture.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'failed' **is **'succeeded'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Elevated **(उन्नत): Raised to a higher level or position.

 
 
• **Example:** The elevated platform provided a better view of the stage.
 
 
 
• **Enjoyed **(आनंद लिया): To take delight or pleasure in something.
 
 
• **Example: **He enjoyed his vacation at the beach.
 
 
 
• **Reserved** (आरक्षित): To keep something for a particular purpose or time.
 
 
• **Example:** The table was reserved for the VIP guests.
